passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding any other law, commencing January 1, 2023, the division shall not approve any notice of intention under Section 3203 within a health protection zone
passages.note: The drilling-permit bar reaches only wells inside a 3,200-foot health protection zone, not the state's production generally.

rows.reasoning: As author of SB 1137 (2021-2022) Gonzalez barred new drilling approvals where "the division shall not approve any notice of intention under Section 3203 within a health protection zone", which shows a restrictive direction on drilling but is limited to land within 3,200 feet of a sensitive receptor. That geographic setback does not establish "Allow no new drilling and let production decline over time", which is statewide, and it is far short of "Phase out fossil fuel production entirely"; no rung names a setback, so the evidence separates the sides without choosing a rung.
